artefact: a temporally held-out replication design for the T4E.38 deterministic MSLP-versus-vorticity basin comparison
declared_by: Edward Jonathan Bentley, maintainer (scientific choice); drafted by Codex at the maintainer's direction and NOT VALID until the maintainer has reviewed and adopted it

why_this_exists.development_result: T4E.38 returned VERTICAL_QUANTITY_SEPARATION_DOMINANT at the exact pre-acquisition boundary: MSLP closer on 10 of 18 fixed development storms, vorticity closer on 7, one exact tie and no refusal.
why_this_exists.remaining_question: Does the same catalogue-seeded centre rule give an MSLP-closer strict majority on the physically unopened 2022-2023 South Pacific storm-time holdout?
why_this_exists.why_declaration_precedes_census: The aggregate fact that the signed catalogue contains 393 in-box observations from 13 storms in 2022-2023 was disclosed in T4E.17. Individual holdout identities, selected times, positions and all ERA5 values remain unopened by this slice. Selection and adjudication are frozen before those rows are parsed.

holdout_population.one_row_per_storm: Use catalogue_join.deepest_per_storm: among admitted interior observations choose the row furthest from either latitude edge; an equal-depth tie retains the earliest row in signed catalogue order; publish rows chronologically.
holdout_population.do_not_filter: NATURE, intensity, T4E.36 pass/fail state and the eventual MSLP/vorticity comparison do not select this population.
holdout_population.minimum_basis: The disclosed source has 13 storms. Up to three may be lost to the already-existing agency and interior rules; fewer than 10 is reported as INSUFFICIENT_HOLDOUT_POPULATION rather than allowed to turn a very small majority into confirmation.

future_exact_acquisition.timestamps: Only the one mechanically selected holdout timestamp per storm may be requested; no intervening ERA5 frame.
future_exact_acquisition.seam_rule: For each variable and timestamp, measure the source-encoding step independently, require 180E/-180 equality within one step, retain the parent 180E column once, and refuse mismatch or an unmeasurable encoding.
future_exact_acquisition.network_boundary: Acquisition is a later slice requiring this declaration's current human adoption, a T4E.39-specific explicit network authorization and the general SPECTRALEARTH_ALLOW_NETWORK gate. Census adoption alone authorizes no request.

frozen_centre_rule.implementation_identity: The rule is textually identical to T4E.38 and must use its tested basin_walk semantics without parameter change.
frozen_centre_rule.catalogue_seed: Choose the native grid sample nearest the IBTrACS latitude/longitude by absolute coordinate distance, with lower array index resolving an exact tie.
frozen_centre_rule.mslp_centre: Repeatedly move to the lowest MSLP sample in the current 3x3 neighbourhood. Resolve equal values by shortest great-circle distance to the catalogue position, then lower row and column. Stop at a local minimum; refuse outer-boundary arrival or a repeated path.
frozen_centre_rule.vorticity_centre: Negate southern-hemisphere 850 hPa relative vorticity and, independently from the same catalogue seed, repeatedly move to the highest sample under the identical 3x3, tie and boundary rules.
frozen_centre_rule.distances: Use catalogue_join.great_circle_km. No agency radius, fitted tolerance or search radius decides the comparison.

row_labels.VERTICAL_QUANTITY_SEPARATION_CANDIDATE: catalogue-to-MSLP distance is strictly less than catalogue-to-vorticity distance
row_labels.CATALOGUE_REANALYSIS_ALIGNMENT_CANDIDATE: catalogue-to-MSLP distance is strictly greater than catalogue-to-vorticity distance
row_labels.EXACT_TIE: the two distances are exactly equal and award neither side
row_labels.REFUSED: either declared basin path or required input cannot be measured; retain the storm in the denominator

decision_declared_before_holdout_opening.denominator: all mechanically selected storms; ties and refusals remain in it
decision_declared_before_holdout_opening.HOLDOUT_SUPPORTS_VERTICAL_QUANTITY_CANDI: MSLP-closer rows reach the strict majority and at least 10 storms were selected
decision_declared_before_holdout_opening.HOLDOUT_FAVOURS_CATALOGUE_REANALYSIS_ALI: vorticity-closer rows reach the strict majority and at least 10 storms were selected
decision_declared_before_holdout_opening.HOLDOUT_MIXED: neither side reaches the strict majority and at least 10 storms were selected
decision_declared_before_holdout_opening.INSUFFICIENT_HOLDOUT_POPULATION: fewer than 10 storms survive the selection fixed above
decision_declared_before_holdout_opening.no_acceptance: Every outcome carries VERDICT NOT_AN_ACCEPTANCE. No development or holdout outcome rescues T4E.36 or T4E.8.

execution_boundary.offline_plan: May validate declaration/source digests and signed-reference availability. It must not parse catalogue rows, open an ERA5 record, enumerate holdout identities or use network.
execution_boundary.census_after_adoption: May parse only the signed catalogue and publish the mechanically selected storm identities, timestamps and positions plus every refusal count. It must not open or acquire ERA5 data.
execution_boundary.acquisition_after_separate_authorization: May request only the census-bound exact timestamps and both declared dateline segments for both declared variables.
execution_boundary.materialisation_and_evaluation: Remain later offline phases. They may not alter the population, basin rule or decision after values are seen.

claim_boundary: A future result can state whether the deterministic T4E.38 MSLP-closer majority recurs on the selected 2022-2023 temporal holdout under the same finite-census rule. It cannot establish statistical generalisation, independence from ERA5 assimilation, cyclone identity, vertical tilt or pressure/surface separation, validate IBTrACS or either field, approve a radius or extractor change, rescue T4E.36 or T4E.8, demonstrate recurrence, or make an atmospheric claim.
